summary: There is a real per-app checkbox in Options → Copilot. The catch: it is per application, so you repeat it in Word, Excel and PowerPoint — and on a work machine an admin may have locked it.

steps.path: Open the app → File → Options → Copilot → uncheck "Enable Copilot". Repeat per app.
On a work computer the option may be greyed out — only the tenant admin can disable Copilot for the OU.

collateral: you have to do it once per Office application
the checkbox can be re-shown after major channel updates
whyTheyDidIt: Copilot is the justification for the M365 price increases; the default has to be on.

sources.label: Microsoft Support — Turn off Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps
Consumer Reports — disable Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps

alternatives.name: LibreOffice
alternatives.why: no assistant, no cloud, no subscription
